main.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original standalone web hero art for an astrology and tarot editorial site; landscape 2560x1440 pixels, 16:9.
Primary request: a surreal monumental classical Greek sanctuary on an absolutely calm reflective sea, in rich monochromatic ultramarine blue and moonstone white. Cinematic, quiet, mysterious, refined fine-art lithograph, with convincingly real detailed stone architecture, not a cartoon.
Scene/backdrop: deep vivid Yves-Klein-like ultramarine sky, no stars. A grand tall sculptural cumulus cloud rises behind the Greek temple in the far-right upper-middle of the image; its entire form remains in frame. Subtle far shore at approximately 73% of image height.
Subject: a fully visible classical Greek temple on the right half of the image, center at 73% image width, seen frontally in slight three-quarter perspective. Elegant triangular pediment, clear tall fluted columns, pale cold moonlit column faces against very deep blue shadow. Temple roof apex around 42% image height and temple foundation around 71% image height. Nothing of temple is cropped. One tiny solitary robed human stands on far right shore for scale, extremely small and distant.
Composition/framing: generous wide landscape. Keep the entire left 48% as empty dark ultramarine open sky suitable for a future white editorial headline: DO NOT render lettering. All architectural and cloud interest is right-weighted. Still water spans lower 27%, reflecting the temple and the cloud with a subtle fine horizontal ripple texture, almost mirror calm. Right-hand temple and cloud fully visible, with ample margin to frame edges.
Lighting/mood: serene cold moonlight, sculptural pale cloud against ultramarine, fine luminous stone highlights, dramatic but soft.
Color palette: duotone range only, darkest ultramarine #171b86, vivid ultramarine #202bb1, moonstone white #dde0ff, intermediate blue values. Preserve rich blue saturation.
Materials/textures: intricate stone columns and pediment, subtle authentic analog lithographic grain consistently throughout image, delicate vintage print texture, no coarse digital noise.
Constraints: clean standalone artwork only, no text, lettering, logos, watermark, border, frame, website UI, astrology diagrams, stars, constellations, gold, neon, aurora, planets, spheres or foreground closeups. No cartoon outlines. Exactly one image.

mist.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original isolated transparent PNG atmospheric overlay for a web hero; landscape 1536x1024 pixels.
Primary request: one horizontal wispy veil of extremely subtle low-lying mist, moon-white with a very faint cool blue tint and delicate fine analog grain.
Composition/framing: fog concentrated in a long narrow irregular band across the bottom-middle of the canvas, around 68% to 83% of canvas height, spanning roughly 80% of width. Very light luminous wisps and delicate tendrils. All wisps feather smoothly into complete transparency on every edge; generous wholly transparent space above and around the veil. This asset will drift horizontally above water in a blue classical dreamscape.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha channel; no solid background and no checkerboard baked into the image. Preserve partial alpha on the soft fog. Output transparent PNG.
Lighting/mood: quiet, soft, restrained, realistic light ground fog, cool moonstone white #dde0ff.
Constraints: fog only. No objects, no water, no land, no architecture, no sky, no frame, no text, no logo, no stars. No gray/black/blue/white opaque rectangular backdrop. No dramatic dense smoke plume. Exactly one image.
